correctness.rationale: Used 24S(n)=(2n+1)^3-(2n+1) at p≥5, noncritical Hensel simple-root lifting, and critical local normal form (c+z)^3-(c+z)=f(c)+z²(3c+z). Square-unit change is bijective for odd p and yields exactly two p^j lifts for valuation 2j; p=2,3 integer-valued finite differences give isometries of p-index classes and periods p^(k+1). CRT yields exact P(m)=m gcd(m,6) and product image count. Independent full residue enumerations p^k=16,27,25,49,121,169,19 match local histograms, and im S mod30 has 18 residues. Unrestricted conclusions rest on local proof, not finite tables.
